title: Degree Growth of Iterates of Curves and Likely Intersections
summary: We study the growth of the bidegree of an ample irreducible curve in $\mathbb{P}^1 \times \mathbb{P}^1$ under a product polynomial endomorphism $\varphi=(f,g)$, where at least one of $f$ and $g$ is non-exceptional. We prove that, if the curve $C$ is not preperiodic under $(f^a,g^b)$ for any $a,b\geq 1$, then the bidegree of $\varphi^n(C)$ is asymptotic to $(\text{deg}(g)^n,\text{deg}(f)^n)$. As an application of this exponential growth, we prove a geometric analogue of Silverman's theorem on the finiteness of $S$-integral points in orbits.
